title: 經皮冠狀動脈介入（PCI）與支架

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出經皮冠狀動脈介入的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Percutaneous coronary intervention and stenting.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：橈動脈路徑、導絲通過、預擴／後擴、藥物塗層支架與 FFR／IVUS 判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Radial access, wire crossing, pre-/post-dilatation, drug-eluting stents and FFR/IVUS.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 止血完成、無併發症。
病灶特徵量化。
同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Haemostasis without complication.
Lesion quantified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
止血完成、無併發症。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Haemostasis without complication.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 支架完全貼壁，TIMI 3 血流。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
止血完成、無併發症。
optionsEn: Full apposition with TIMI 3 flow.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Haemostasis without complication.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 支架完全貼壁，TIMI 3 血流。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Full apposition with TIMI 3 flow.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依經皮冠狀動脈介入的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Percutaneous coronary intervention and stenting.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
止血完成、無併發症。
病灶可被擴張。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Haemostasis without complication.
Lesion dilatable.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 經皮冠狀動脈介入的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Percutaneous coronary intervention and stenting.

steps.title: 血管路徑與導引導管
steps.objective: 建立橈動脈路徑並送入導引導管。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain radial access and engage the guide catheter.
steps.instruction: 超音波導引穿刺橈動脈，雞尾酒（verapamil、肝素）預防痙攣；6F 導引導管（EBU／JL 左、JR 右）同軸嵌入開口。
steps.instructionEn: Ultrasound-guided radial puncture; verapamil/heparin cocktail; 6F guide (EBU/JL left, JR right) coaxially engaged.
steps.observation: 確認壓力波形無 damping。
steps.observationEn: Confirm no pressure damping.
steps.failure: 壓力波形 damping 代表開口狹窄或深插，可致夾層。
steps.failureEn: Damping indicates ostial disease or deep engagement, risking dissection.
steps.check: 導管同軸、壓力正常。
steps.checkEn: Guide coaxial with normal pressure.

knowledge.title: 橈動脈優勢
knowledge.text: 出血併發症與死亡率低於股動脈。
knowledge.textEn: Fewer bleeding complications and lower mortality than femoral.

quiz.question: 「血管路徑與導引導管」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Access and guide catheter'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
導管同軸、壓力正常。
止血完成、無併發症。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Guide coaxial with normal pressure.
Haemostasis without complication.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 抗凝與病灶評估
steps.objective: 給予抗凝並定量病灶。
steps.objectiveEn: Anticoagulate and quantify the lesion.
steps.instruction: 肝素 70–100 U/kg（ACT 250–300 s）；多角度造影，必要時 FFR（≤ 0.80）或 IVUS／OCT 評估。
steps.instructionEn: Heparin 70–100 U/kg (ACT 250–300 s); multiple views, FFR (≤ 0.80) or IVUS/OCT when indicated.
steps.observation: 記錄血管直徑、病灶長度與鈣化。
steps.observationEn: Record vessel diameter, lesion length and calcification.
steps.failure: 以目測決定中度狹窄是否治療會造成過度或不足治療。
steps.failureEn: Eyeballing intermediate lesions leads to over- or under-treatment.
steps.check: 病灶特徵量化。
steps.checkEn: Lesion quantified.

knowledge.title: 生理學導引
knowledge.text: FAME 試驗顯示 FFR 導引改善結果。
knowledge.textEn: FAME showed better outcomes with FFR guidance.

quiz.question: 「抗凝與病灶評估」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anticoagulation and lesion assessment'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
病灶特徵量化。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Lesion quantified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 導絲通過與預擴張
steps.objective: 將導絲送過病灶並預擴張。
steps.objectiveEn: Cross the lesion with a wire and pre-dilate.
steps.instruction: 0.014 吋工作導絲穿過病灶至遠端，確認在真腔；半順應性球囊（直徑比 0.8–1.0）預擴 10–14 atm。
steps.instructionEn: 0.014-inch workhorse wire across to the distal vessel, confirm true lumen; semi-compliant balloon (0.8–1.0 ratio) at 10–14 atm.
steps.observation: 觀察球囊腰部是否消失。
steps.observationEn: Check that the balloon waist resolves.
steps.failure: 導絲入假腔會造成夾層與穿孔。
steps.failureEn: A subintimal wire causes dissection and perforation.
steps.check: 病灶可被擴張。
steps.checkEn: Lesion dilatable.

knowledge.title: 鈣化處理
knowledge.text: 腰部不消失時使用切割球囊、旋磨或血管內碎石。
knowledge.textEn: Persistent waist: cutting balloon, rotablation or intravascular lithotripsy.

quiz.question: 「導絲通過與預擴張」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Wire crossing and pre-dilatation'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
導管同軸、壓力正常。
病灶可被擴張。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Guide coaxial with normal pressure.
Lesion dilatable.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 支架置放
steps.objective: 置放藥物塗層支架覆蓋全病灶。
steps.objectiveEn: Deploy a drug-eluting stent covering the whole lesion.
steps.instruction: 支架長度覆蓋病灶兩端各 2–3 mm 正常段；以標稱壓釋放，再以非順應性球囊後擴至 16–20 atm 使貼壁。
steps.instructionEn: Length to cover 2–3 mm of normal vessel either side; deploy at nominal pressure, then post-dilate with a non-compliant balloon at 16–20 atm.
steps.observation: 造影／IVUS 確認貼壁、無邊緣夾層。
steps.observationEn: Angiography/IVUS to confirm apposition and no edge dissection.
steps.failure: 支架貼壁不良是晚期血栓的主因。
steps.failureEn: Malapposition drives late stent thrombosis.
steps.check: 支架完全貼壁，TIMI 3 血流。
steps.checkEn: Full apposition with TIMI 3 flow.

knowledge.title: 雙重抗血小板
knowledge.text: ACS 後 12 個月、穩定病 6 個月為基準，依出血風險調整。
knowledge.textEn: Baseline 12 months after ACS and 6 months in stable disease, adjusted for bleeding risk.

quiz.question: 「支架置放」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Stent deployment'?
options: 止血完成、無併發症。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
支架完全貼壁，TIMI 3 血流。
optionsEn: Haemostasis without complication.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Full apposition with TIMI 3 flow.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 最終造影、止血與術後
steps.objective: 確認結果並安全止血。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm the result and achieve haemostasis.
steps.instruction: 多角度最終造影；移除鞘管後以止血帶採 patent haemostasis 2 小時；監測穿刺處、心電圖與肌鈣蛋白。
steps.instructionEn: Final views; remove the sheath and apply a radial band for patent haemostasis for 2 hours; monitor the site, ECG and troponin.
steps.observation: 記錄對比劑用量與輻射劑量。
steps.observationEn: Record contrast volume and radiation dose.
steps.failure: 橈動脈閉塞可由過度壓迫造成。
steps.failureEn: Radial occlusion results from excessive compression.
steps.check: 止血完成、無併發症。
steps.checkEn: Haemostasis without complication.

knowledge.title: 對比劑腎病變
knowledge.text: 預先水化並限制劑量（< 3× eGFR mL）。
knowledge.textEn: Pre-hydrate and limit volume (< 3 × eGFR mL).

quiz.question: 「最終造影、止血與術後」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Final angiography, haemostasis and aftercare'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
止血完成、無併發症。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Haemostasis without complication.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 病灶可被擴張。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
導管同軸、壓力正常。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Lesion dilatable.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Guide coaxial with normal pressure.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 止血完成、無併發症。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Haemostasis without complication.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出經皮冠狀動脈介入的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Percutaneous coronary intervention and stenting and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 支架完全貼壁，TIMI 3 血流。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Full apposition with TIMI 3 flow.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出冠狀動脈血管攝影的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Coronary angiography.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：投照角度、血管命名、TIMI 血流與狹窄定量。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Projection angles, vessel nomenclature, TIMI flow and stenosis quantification.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「投照角度」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Projection angles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依冠狀動脈血管攝影的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Coronary angiography.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 已正確完成「投照角度」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'Projection angles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 冠狀動脈血管攝影的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Coronary angiography.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：投照角度
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「投照角度」在冠狀動脈血管攝影中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Projection angles' within Coronary angiography, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「投照角度」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Projection angles': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「投照角度」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Projection angles'.
steps.failure: 若「投照角度」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Projection angles' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「投照角度」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Projection angles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「投照角度」是冠狀動脈血管攝影的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Projection angles' is a core component of Coronary angiography; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：投照角度」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Projection angles'?
options: 已正確完成「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「投照角度」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Projection angles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：血管命名
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「血管命名」在冠狀動脈血管攝影中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'vessel nomenclature' within Coronary angiography, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「血管命名」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'vessel nomenclature': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「血管命名」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'vessel nomenclature'.
steps.failure: 若「血管命名」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'vessel nomenclature' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「血管命名」是冠狀動脈血管攝影的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'vessel nomenclature' is a core component of Coronary angiography; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：血管命名」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: vessel nomenclature'?
options: 已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: 'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 3：TIMI 血流與狹窄定量
steps.titleEn: Key element 3: TIMI flow and stenosis quantification
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」在冠狀動脈血管攝影中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' within Coronary angiography, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification'.
steps.failure: 若「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」是冠狀動脈血管攝影的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' is a core component of Coronary angiography; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 3：TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 3: TIMI flow and stenosis quantification'?
options: 已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「投照角度」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Projection angles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「TIMI 血流與狹窄定量」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'TIMI flow and stenosis quantification' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出冠狀動脈血管攝影的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Coronary angiography and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「血管命名」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'vessel nomenclature' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「投照角度」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'Projection angles' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 準備與安全（免費試學）

steps.title: 準備與安全
steps.objective: 說明ST 段上升心肌梗塞：Door-to-balloon的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where STEMI: door-to-balloon pathway applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：12 導程判讀、primary PCI 啟動、抗血小板與纖溶替代。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: 12-lead recognition, primary PCI activation, antiplatelets and fibrinolysis alternatives.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 12 導程判讀、primary PCI 啟動、抗血小板與纖溶替代。
knowledge.textEn: 12-lead recognition, primary PCI activation, antiplatelets and fibrinolysis alternatives.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「準備與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Preparation and safety'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
準備清單完成。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
已正確完成「primary PCI 啟動」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
'primary PCI activation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
準備清單完成。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「primary PCI 啟動」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Preparation checklist complete.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'primary PCI activation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: ST 段上升心肌梗塞：Door-to-balloon的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of STEMI: door-to-balloon pathway.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：12 導程判讀
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「12 導程判讀」在ST 段上升心肌梗塞：Door-to-balloon中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform '12-lead recognition' within STEMI: door-to-balloon pathway, in sequence.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Treatment and evidence'?
options: 病例推理完整。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 病例應用與自我測驗
steps.objective: 以一個病例或情境應用本題。
steps.objectiveEn: Apply the topic to a case or scenario.
steps.instruction: 描述情境→列出鑑別→選擇處置→預測結果→比較實際。
steps.instructionEn: Describe the scenario → list differentials → choose management → predict outcome → compare with reality.
steps.observation: 完成病例紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Complete the case record.
steps.failure: 跳過鑑別診斷直接下結論是危險的捷徑。
steps.failureEn: Skipping the differential is a dangerous shortcut.
steps.check: 病例推理完整。
steps.checkEn: Case reasoning complete.

knowledge.title: 反思
knowledge.text: 每個病例都應回答：我學到什麼、下次會怎麼做。
knowledge.textEn: Every case should answer: what did I learn, what will I do differently.

quiz.question: 「病例應用與自我測驗」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
病例推理完整。
optionsEn: The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
Case reasoning complete.

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明FFR、IVUS 與 OCT 冠狀動脈影像的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where FFR, IVUS and OCT coronary imaging applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估。
knowledge.textEn: Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: FFR、IVUS 與 OCT 冠狀動脈影像的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of FFR, IVUS and OCT coronary imaging.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」在FFR、IVUS 與 OCT 冠狀動脈影像中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' within FFR, IVUS and OCT coronary imaging, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment'.
steps.failure: 若「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」是FFR、IVUS 與 OCT 冠狀動脈影像的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' is a core component of FFR, IVUS and OCT coronary imaging; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment'?
options: 準備清單完成。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 已正確完成「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Quality, error and safety review'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「生理學導引血運重建與斑塊／支架貼壁評估」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'Physiology-guided revascularisation and plaque/stent apposition assessment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: 維基百科（中文）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出慢性完全阻塞的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Chronic total occlusion intervention.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：順行／逆行技術、J-CTO 分數與併發症。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Antegrade/retrograde techniques, J-CTO score and complications.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「順行／逆行技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依慢性完全阻塞的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Chronic total occlusion intervention.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 已正確完成「J-CTO 分數與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: 'J-CTO score and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 慢性完全阻塞的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Chronic total occlusion intervention.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：順行／逆行技術
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「順行／逆行技術」在慢性完全阻塞中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' within Chronic total occlusion intervention, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「順行／逆行技術」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「順行／逆行技術」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques'.
steps.failure: 若「順行／逆行技術」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「順行／逆行技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「順行／逆行技術」是慢性完全阻塞的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' is a core component of Chronic total occlusion intervention; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：順行／逆行技術」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Antegrade/retrograde techniques'?
options: 已正確完成「順行／逆行技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：J-CTO 分數與併發症
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: J-CTO score and complications
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「J-CTO 分數與併發症」在慢性完全阻塞中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'J-CTO score and complications' within Chronic total occlusion intervention, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「J-CTO 分數與併發症」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'J-CTO score and complications': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「J-CTO 分數與併發症」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'J-CTO score and complications'.
steps.failure: 若「J-CTO 分數與併發症」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'J-CTO score and complications' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「J-CTO 分數與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'J-CTO score and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「J-CTO 分數與併發症」是慢性完全阻塞的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'J-CTO score and complications' is a core component of Chronic total occlusion intervention; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：J-CTO 分數與併發症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: J-CTO score and complications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「J-CTO 分數與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「順行／逆行技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'J-CTO score and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 已正確完成「J-CTO 分數與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「順行／逆行技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'J-CTO score and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「J-CTO 分數與併發症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
'J-CTO score and complications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出慢性完全阻塞的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Chronic total occlusion intervention and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
