steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 已正確完成「順行／逆行技術」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: 'Antegrade/retrograde techniques' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Rotational atherectomy and calcified lesions applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：旋磨、血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Rotablation, intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 旋磨、血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊。
knowledge.textEn: Rotablation, intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 已正確完成「旋磨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
已正確完成「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
optionsEn: 'Rotablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 準備清單完成。
已正確完成「旋磨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
'Rotablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Rotational atherectomy and calcified lesions.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：旋磨
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「旋磨」在旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Rotablation' within Rotational atherectomy and calcified lesions, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「旋磨」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Rotablation': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「旋磨」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Rotablation'.
steps.failure: 若「旋磨」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Rotablation' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「旋磨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Rotablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「旋磨」是旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Rotablation' is a core component of Rotational atherectomy and calcified lesions; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：旋磨」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Rotablation'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「旋磨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Rotablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」在旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' within Rotational atherectomy and calcified lesions, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons'.
steps.failure: 若「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」是旋磨術與鈣化病灶處理的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' is a core component of Rotational atherectomy and calcified lesions; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons'?
options: 已正確完成「旋磨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'Rotablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Quality, error and safety review'?
options: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「血管內碎石術（IVL）與切割球囊」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'intravascular lithotripsy and cutting balloons' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出經導管主動脈瓣置換的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Transcatheter aortic valve implantation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：CT 瓣環測量、瓣膜尺寸選擇、經股路徑、瓣周漏與傳導阻滯。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: CT annulus sizing, valve selection, transfemoral access, paravalvular leak and conduction block.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 路徑與起搏就緒。
閉合完成、監測安排。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Access and pacing ready.
Closure done and monitoring arranged.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 閉合完成、監測安排。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Closure done and monitoring arranged.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 路徑與起搏就緒。
瓣膜位置正確。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Access and pacing ready.
Valve correctly positioned.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
規劃完成。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Plan complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依經導管主動脈瓣置換的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Transcatheter aortic valve implantation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 規劃完成。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
瓣膜位置正確。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Plan complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Valve correctly positioned.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 經導管主動脈瓣置換的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Transcatheter aortic valve implantation.

steps.title: CT 規劃與瓣膜選擇
steps.objective: 以 CT 測量瓣環並選擇瓣膜尺寸與路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Measure the annulus on CT and choose valve size and access.
steps.instruction: 心電門控 CT 測瓣環周長／面積、冠狀動脈開口高度（> 10–12 mm）、瓣葉鈣化與股髂動脈直徑（≥ 5.5 mm）。
steps.instructionEn: ECG-gated CT: annular perimeter/area, coronary heights (> 10–12 mm), leaflet calcium and iliofemoral diameters (≥ 5.5 mm).
steps.observation: 記錄瓣膜型號與尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Record valve model and size.
steps.failure: 尺寸過大致瓣環破裂，過小致瓣周漏。
steps.failureEn: Oversizing ruptures the annulus; undersizing causes paravalvular leak.
steps.check: 規劃完成。
steps.checkEn: Plan complete.

knowledge.title: 心臟團隊
knowledge.text: 外科與介入共同決策。
knowledge.textEn: Joint surgical–interventional decision-making.

quiz.question: 「CT 規劃與瓣膜選擇」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'CT planning and valve selection'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
規劃完成。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Plan complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 血管路徑與暫時節律器
steps.objective: 建立經股路徑與快速起搏準備。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish transfemoral access and rapid-pacing capability.
steps.instruction: 超音波導引股動脈穿刺，預置縫合器（Perclose）；對側股動脈作 pigtail，股靜脈置暫時節律器導線至右心室（或以導絲起搏）。
steps.instructionEn: Ultrasound-guided femoral puncture with pre-closure devices; contralateral pigtail; femoral venous temporary pacing wire to the RV (or wire pacing).
steps.observation: 測試起搏捕獲。
steps.observationEn: Test pacing capture.
steps.failure: 血管併發症與路徑直徑和鈣化相關。
steps.failureEn: Vascular complications relate to vessel size and calcium.
steps.check: 路徑與起搏就緒。
steps.checkEn: Access and pacing ready.

knowledge.title: 替代路徑
knowledge.text: 經鎖骨下、經頸動脈或經心尖。
knowledge.textEn: Subclavian, carotid or transapical.

quiz.question: 「血管路徑與暫時節律器」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Vascular access and temporary pacing'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
路徑與起搏就緒。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Access and pacing ready.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 跨瓣與球囊預擴（可選）
steps.objective: 導絲跨過狹窄瓣膜並定位。
steps.objectiveEn: Cross the stenotic valve and position the wire.
steps.instruction: AL1 導管與直導絲跨瓣，交換為預塑形硬導絲至左心室心尖；快速起搏 180／分下球囊預擴（鈣化重者）。
steps.instructionEn: AL1 catheter and straight wire to cross, exchange for a pre-shaped stiff wire in the LV apex; balloon pre-dilatation under rapid pacing at 180/min for heavy calcium.
steps.observation: 確認導絲位置穩定。
steps.observationEn: Confirm stable wire position.
steps.failure: 導絲穿孔左心室致心包填塞。
steps.failureEn: LV perforation by the wire causes tamponade.
steps.check: 跨瓣完成。
steps.checkEn: Valve crossed.

knowledge.title: 直接植入
knowledge.text: 多數自擴張瓣膜可免預擴。
knowledge.textEn: Many self-expanding valves can be implanted without pre-dilatation.

quiz.question: 「跨瓣與球囊預擴（可選）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Valve crossing and optional pre-dilatation'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
路徑與起搏就緒。
跨瓣完成。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Access and pacing ready.
Valve crossed.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 瓣膜釋放
steps.objective: 在正確深度釋放瓣膜。
steps.objectiveEn: Deploy the valve at the correct depth.
steps.instruction: 以 cusp-overlap 投影對齊，球囊擴張瓣在快速起搏下釋放，自擴張瓣緩慢釋放並可回收；目標植入深度 3–5 mm 於瓣環下。
steps.instructionEn: Align in the cusp-overlap view; balloon-expandable valves deploy under rapid pacing, self-expanding valves slowly with recapture capability; target depth 3–5 mm below the annulus.
steps.observation: 即刻造影與 TEE／TTE 評估。
steps.observationEn: Immediate angiography and echo.
steps.failure: 植入過深造成傳導阻滯與瓣周漏。
steps.failureEn: Deep implantation causes conduction block and leak.
steps.check: 瓣膜位置正確。
steps.checkEn: Valve correctly positioned.

knowledge.title: 瓣周漏處理
knowledge.text: 後擴張或第二瓣膜。
knowledge.textEn: Post-dilatation or a second valve.

quiz.question: 「瓣膜釋放」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Valve deployment'?
options: 跨瓣完成。
瓣膜位置正確。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Valve crossed.
Valve correctly positioned.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 血管閉合與術後監測
steps.objective: 閉合路徑並監測傳導與血管。
steps.objectiveEn: Close access and monitor conduction and vessels.
steps.instruction: 收緊縫合器並造影確認無滲漏；心電監測 24–48 小時（新 LBBB／高度阻滯），次日心臟超音波，抗血栓依指引。
steps.instructionEn: Tighten pre-closure sutures and confirm by angiography; ECG monitoring 24–48 h (new LBBB/high-grade block), echo next day, antithrombotics per guideline.
steps.observation: 記錄 PR／QRS 變化。
steps.observationEn: Record PR/QRS changes.
steps.failure: 延遲性完全阻滯可在出院後發生。
steps.failureEn: Delayed complete block can occur after discharge.
steps.check: 閉合完成、監測安排。
steps.checkEn: Closure done and monitoring arranged.

knowledge.title: 低風險族群證據
knowledge.text: PARTNER 3 與 Evolut Low Risk 試驗。
knowledge.textEn: PARTNER 3 and Evolut Low Risk trials.

quiz.question: 「血管閉合與術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Vascular closure and monitoring'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
閉合完成、監測安排。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
規劃完成。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Closure done and monitoring arranged.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Plan complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 瓣膜位置正確。
規劃完成。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Valve correctly positioned.
Plan complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出經導管主動脈瓣置換的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Transcatheter aortic valve implantation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 跨瓣完成。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Valve crossed.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 規劃完成。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
跨瓣完成。
optionsEn: Plan complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Valve crossed.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補（MitraClip）

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：經食道超音波導引、房中隔穿刺與夾合策略。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: TOE guidance, transseptal puncture and clipping strategy.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：經食道超音波導引
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「經食道超音波導引」在經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'TOE guidance' within Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「經食道超音波導引」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'TOE guidance': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「經食道超音波導引」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'TOE guidance'.
steps.failure: 若「經食道超音波導引」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'TOE guidance' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「經食道超音波導引」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'TOE guidance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「經食道超音波導引」是經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'TOE guidance' is a core component of Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：經食道超音波導引」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: TOE guidance'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「經食道超音波導引」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'TOE guidance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：房中隔穿刺與夾合策略
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: transseptal puncture and clipping strategy
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」在經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy' within Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy'.
steps.failure: 若「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」是經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy' is a core component of Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: transseptal puncture and clipping strategy'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「經食道超音波導引」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'TOE guidance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出經導管二尖瓣緣對緣修補的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 已正確完成「經食道超音波導引」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「房中隔穿刺與夾合策略」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'TOE guidance' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'transseptal puncture and clipping strategy' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出左心耳封堵的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Left atrial appendage occlusion.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依左心耳封堵的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Left atrial appendage occlusion.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 左心耳封堵的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Left atrial appendage occlusion.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」在左心耳封堵中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' within Left atrial appendage occlusion, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus'.
steps.failure: 若「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」是左心耳封堵的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' is a core component of Left atrial appendage occlusion; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出左心耳封堵的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Left atrial appendage occlusion and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「心房顫動抗凝禁忌者的封堵器植入與裝置相關血栓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Occluder implantation for anticoagulation-ineligible AF and device-related thrombus' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 心房中隔缺損／卵圓孔封堵

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出心房中隔缺損／卵圓孔封堵的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of ASD/PFO closure.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：隱源性中風的 PFO 封堵指徵與裝置尺寸選擇。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: PFO closure indications after cryptogenic stroke and device sizing.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
