title: 希氏束／左束支起搏
titleEn: His-bundle and left bundle branch pacing

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明希氏束／左束支起搏的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where His-bundle and left bundle branch pacing applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
準備清單完成。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Preparation checklist complete.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 希氏束／左束支起搏的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of His-bundle and left bundle branch pacing.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」在希氏束／左束支起搏中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' within His-bundle and left bundle branch pacing, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing'.
steps.failure: 若「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」是希氏束／左束支起搏的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' is a core component of His-bundle and left bundle branch pacing; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 已正確完成「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
optionsEn: 'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Quality, error and safety review'?
options: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
準備清單完成。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「生理性起搏的導線定位與電位判讀」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'Lead positioning and electrogram criteria for physiological pacing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

title: 心房顫動肺靜脈隔離
titleEn: Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出心房顫動肺靜脈隔離的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融、3D 標測與食道保護。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Radiofrequency, cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation, 3D mapping and oesophageal protection.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「3D 標測與食道保護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Radiofrequency' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依心房顫動肺靜脈隔離的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 心房顫動肺靜脈隔離的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」在心房顫動肺靜脈隔離中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Radiofrequency' within Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Radiofrequency': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Radiofrequency'.
steps.failure: 若「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Radiofrequency' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Radiofrequency' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」是心房顫動肺靜脈隔離的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Radiofrequency' is a core component of Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Radiofrequency'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Radiofrequency' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：3D 標測與食道保護
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「3D 標測與食道保護」在心房顫動肺靜脈隔離中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' within Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「3D 標測與食道保護」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「3D 標測與食道保護」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation'.
steps.failure: 若「3D 標測與食道保護」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「3D 標測與食道保護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「3D 標測與食道保護」是心房顫動肺靜脈隔離的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' is a core component of Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：3D 標測與食道保護」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「3D 標測與食道保護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出心房顫動肺靜脈隔離的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「射頻／冷凍／脈衝電場消融」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'Radiofrequency' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 已正確完成「3D 標測與食道保護」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: 'cryoballoon and pulsed-field ablation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出上心室心搏過速電燒的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of SVT ablation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：電生理檢查、慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Electrophysiology study, slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依上心室心搏過速電燒的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for SVT ablation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 上心室心搏過速電燒的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of SVT ablation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：電生理檢查
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「電生理檢查」在上心室心搏過速電燒中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Electrophysiology study' within SVT ablation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「電生理檢查」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Electrophysiology study': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「電生理檢查」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Electrophysiology study'.
steps.failure: 若「電生理檢查」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Electrophysiology study' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「電生理檢查」是上心室心搏過速電燒的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Electrophysiology study' is a core component of SVT ablation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：電生理檢查」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Electrophysiology study'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」在上心室心搏過速電燒中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation' within SVT ablation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation'.
steps.failure: 若「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」是上心室心搏過速電燒的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation' is a core component of SVT ablation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「慢徑路消融與 WPW 旁路定位」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'slow-pathway ablation and accessory-pathway localisation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出上心室心搏過速電燒的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of SVT ablation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「電生理檢查」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Electrophysiology study' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出心室頻脈基質消融的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：疤痕標測、心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Scar mapping, epicardial access and haemodynamic support.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 已正確完成「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依心室頻脈基質消融的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 心室頻脈基質消融的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：疤痕標測
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「疤痕標測」在心室頻脈基質消融中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Scar mapping' within Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「疤痕標測」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Scar mapping': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「疤痕標測」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Scar mapping'.
steps.failure: 若「疤痕標測」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Scar mapping' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「疤痕標測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Scar mapping' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「疤痕標測」是心室頻脈基質消融的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Scar mapping' is a core component of Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：疤痕標測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Scar mapping'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「疤痕標測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Scar mapping' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: epicardial access and haemodynamic support
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」在心室頻脈基質消融中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' within Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support'.
steps.failure: 若「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」是心室頻脈基質消融的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' is a core component of Ventricular tachycardia substrate ablation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: epicardial access and haemodynamic support'?
options: 已正確完成「心外膜路徑與血流動力學支持」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: 'epicardial access and haemodynamic support' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。

steps.instruction: 執行「節律」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。

knowledge.textEn: 'Systematic rhythm' is a core component of 12-lead ECG interpretation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 準備清單完成。
已正確完成「射出分率」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「瓣膜評估與舒張功能」並以文字或數據留下證據。
判讀有依據且下一步明確。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
'ejection fraction' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'valvular assessment and diastolic function' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。

steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。

steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：左心耳血栓
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「左心耳血栓」在經食道心臟超音波中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Appendage thrombus' within Transoesophageal echocardiography, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「左心耳血栓」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Appendage thrombus': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「左心耳血栓」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Appendage thrombus'.
steps.failure: 若「左心耳血栓」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Appendage thrombus' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「左心耳血栓」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Appendage thrombus' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

準備清單完成。
已正確完成「心內膜炎贅生物與術中監測」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

'endocarditis vegetations and intra-operative monitoring' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: H2FPEF 分數、SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理。
knowledge.textEn: H2FPEF score, SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

quiz.question: 「機制與病理生理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Mechanism and pathophysiology'?
options: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
已正確完成「H2FPEF 分數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
病例推理完整。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
optionsEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.
'H2FPEF score' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Case reasoning complete.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵名詞與分類
steps.objective: 建立本題的名詞表與分類架構。
steps.objectiveEn: Build the glossary and classification for this topic.
steps.instruction: 列出 8–12 個關鍵名詞，各以一句話定義，並以表格呈現分類。
steps.instructionEn: List 8–12 key terms with one-sentence definitions and tabulate the classification.
steps.observation: 完成名詞表。
steps.observationEn: Complete the glossary.
steps.failure: 名詞混用會導致後續判斷錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mixing terms leads to later misjudgement.
steps.check: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
steps.checkEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.

knowledge.title: 分類的目的
knowledge.text: 分類應服務於治療決策或預後。
knowledge.textEn: Classification should serve treatment decisions or prognosis.

quiz.question: 「關鍵名詞與分類」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key terms and classification'?
options: 總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
病例推理完整。
optionsEn: The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
Case reasoning complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 臨床表現與診斷

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：H2FPEF 分數
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「H2FPEF 分數」在射出分率保留型心臟衰竭中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'H2FPEF score' within Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「H2FPEF 分數」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'H2FPEF score': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「H2FPEF 分數」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'H2FPEF score'.
steps.failure: 若「H2FPEF 分數」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'H2FPEF score' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「H2FPEF 分數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'H2FPEF score' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「H2FPEF 分數」是射出分率保留型心臟衰竭的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'H2FPEF score' is a core component of Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：H2FPEF 分數」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: H2FPEF score'?
options: 已正確完成「H2FPEF 分數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
已正確完成「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
病例推理完整。
optionsEn: 'H2FPEF score' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Case reasoning complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」在射出分率保留型心臟衰竭中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management' within Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management'.
steps.failure: 若「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」是射出分率保留型心臟衰竭的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management' is a core component of Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management'?
options: 已正確完成「H2FPEF 分數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「SGLT2 抑制劑與共病管理」並以文字或數據留下證據。
病例推理完整。
名詞表完整且分類合理。
optionsEn: 'H2FPEF score' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'SGLT2 inhibitors and comorbidity management' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Case reasoning complete.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
